questions.q: What did Milentije buy Mum for her birthday?
questions.e: In the video: "Burek. Šta da ti kupim u pet ujutru, samo je pekara otvorena." — burek. What should I buy you at five in the morning, only the bakery is open.

questions.q: What is written on the card with the flowers?
o: I'll be waiting for you tonight
To the most beautiful flower from the garden of paradise
questions.e: In the video: "Kaže: najlepšem cvetu iz rajske bašte." — it says: to the most beautiful flower from the garden of paradise.

questions.q: What does Roza say about men's names?
o: She has always had trouble with them
questions.e: In the video: "Pa, znaš da sam uvek imala problem sa muškim imenima." — well, you know I've always had trouble with men's names.

questions.q: Whom did Roza invite to dinner?
questions.e: In the video: "Večeras, brate, zvala sam ga na večeru." — tonight, man, I invited him to dinner.

questions.q: What «secret» does Roza add to her apple pie?
questions.e: In the video: "Ja lepo stavim vanilin šećer, doduše to stavim na kraju, i stavim malo origana." — I nicely add vanilla sugar, although at the end, and I add a little oregano.

questions.q: What does Milentije find in the oven?
questions.e: In the video: "Jao, Roso, otkud teniska loptica u rerni?" — oh, Roza, where does a tennis ball in the oven come from?

questions.q: What news do Jovanka and Miša hear?
questions.e: In the video: "Mama ima dečka." — Mum has a boyfriend.

questions.q: What is «Lazar»'s real name?
questions.e: In the video: "Hvala, pravo ime mi je Slavko, ali pošto me Rosa zove Lazar, neka ostane tako." — thanks, my real name is Slavko, but since Rosa calls me Lazar, let it stay that way.

questions.q: What does the husband recall about his wife's gold bag?
o: She wanted silver but he insisted on gold
It was too expensive for him
questions.e: In the video: "A sećam se kad si htela srebrnu torbu umesto te zlatne torbe, znaš?" — I remember you wanted a silver bag instead of that gold one.

questions.q: What do they say about the flowers for 'Mom'?
o: The flower shop must have made a mistake
The flowers were meant for her sister
questions.e: In the video: "Sasvim sigurno su pogrešili u cvećari." — the flower shop must have made a mistake.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Sram te bilo, *zlotvore* jedan.
questions.e: zlotvor — villain.

questions.q: Ljubomora je pretirani strah od *gubitka*.
questions.e: gubitak — loss; gubitka is the genitive.

questions.q: Pa se još pitam šta će ti *biber* u piti od jabuka.
questions.e: biber — pepper.

questions.q: Daj mi *cimet*.
questions.e: cimet — cinnamon.

questions.q: Kako se kaže mera za *dragocenost*?
questions.e: dragocenost — preciousness.

questions.q: Svaka *kuvarica* ima svoj recept.
questions.e: kuvarica — a female cook.

questions.q: A kad se mama *uda*, šta ćeš ti da radiš?
questions.e: udati se — (of a woman) to get married.

questions.q: Mogu da vam čuvam decu, pa da spavamo kao *braća*.
questions.e: braća — brothers.

questions.t: Choose the translation of the highlighted word
questions.q: Eto, *minđuše* su bile skupe.
questions.e: minđuše — earrings.

questions.t: Choose the translation of the highlighted word
questions.q: Ne smeš da *zaključavaš* vrata.
questions.e: zaključavati — to lock.

questions.q: Ti si čovek sa mnogo dobrih ___.
questions.e: After «mnogo» the genitive plural: osobina.

questions.q: Pa moram i ja s nekim da se ___.
questions.e: After «da» the present tense; 1st sg.: družim se.

questions.q: Kome ćeš ti da ___?
questions.e: After «da» the 2nd sg.: pripadneš.

questions.q: Mogla si nešto ___ da obučeš.
questions.e: After «nešto» the neuter adjective: nešto drugo.

questions.q: Poslednji put je bio u ___ 1984. godine.
questions.e: «U» for a place takes the locative: u pozorištu.

questions.q: Ja sam mislio kod ___.
questions.e: The preposition «kod» takes the genitive: kod vas.

questions.q: Ljudi, idem da vidim šta je sa ___.
questions.e: «Sa» takes the instrumental: sa pitom.

questions.q: Ne, ne možeš, zamrznućeš se na ___.
questions.e: «Na» for a place takes the locative: na terasi.

questions.q: Sasvim sigurno su pogrešili u ___.
questions.e: «u» with a location takes the locative: u cvećari.

questions.q: Ne ___ da zaključavaš vrata od ovog stana!
questions.e: Addressing one person: ti smeš.
